description: This PHP abstract class defines methods for processing and managing leave-related email notifications within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to retrieve email subscribers, recipients based on roles or specific employees, leave details, and comments associated with leave requests. The class leverages various traits and entities to facilitate email notification handling for leave workflows.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class providing foundational email processing functionalities for leave management notifications, including subscriber retrieval, recipient management, leave detail aggregation, and comment fetching.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeaveRequestCommentService used for fetching leave request comments.

methods.name: getSubscribersForEvent
methods.description: Retrieves email subscribers for a specific notification event identified by its ID.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns recipients representing employees with a specific role, filtering out those without a work email.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the recipient corresponding to the given employee, if they have a work email.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Gets recipients of email notifications based on predefined email event names, such as leave apply or approve.

methods.name: getSupervisors
methods.description: Returns recipients representing the supervisors of a given employee.

methods.name: getLeaveDetailsByDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Generates a summary of leave details from an array of DetailedLeave objects, including date, time, duration, and leave type.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Fetches and formats comments associated with a specific leave request ID.
